description.value:
Duration as Dead Hand's Grip

Traits Ghost-Static

Dead Hand's Grip can now target a second machine in the same casting, splitting the effect between them.

When you use Dead Hand's Grip, you may target two machines instead of one. The effect is split between them: each may be made to perform a function of half the complexity, or a hostile machine is seized in place for half as long, rounded down to a minimum of 1 round. You cannot spend both halves on one machine.
